measurement_limitations: Independent per-stage percentiles cannot be added. Raw readback can overlap input/app drawing; frame_wrapper is not readback for async code.
Formal binaries have no Linux instrumentation: first raw ID, dispatch/capture timestamps and first published response frame remain null.
Diagnostics change timing and are reported separately; they cannot replace uninstrumented A/B.
Stage residual is a sum of separate same-host intervals subtracted from Mac E2E, not a synchronized one-way network estimate.
Root/process ownership and stable compositor object binding retained; non-GNOME fallback may still wait for X-server replies.
Profiled baseline samples include tracer overhead and are excluded from the uninstrumented comparison.

installed_smoke.note: Different local content size from formal A/B; validation only, not pooled into comparison.

observed: kernel shmem allocation and page initialization sampled
profiling.scope: metadata-only, no read/write buffer tracing; excludes formal A/B
profiling.limits: Samples establish candidate mechanisms, not a precise percentage attribution of SHM wait.

base.note: 30 FPS frame admission cap; encode duration jitter can shorten adjacent write intervals. No fps or pacing code changed.

candidate.note: 30 FPS frame admission cap; encode duration jitter can shorten adjacent write intervals. No fps or pacing code changed.

implementation.pipeline: Reusable private GBM linear target imported by DRI3; XRender output unchanged; XSync flush followed by dma-buf GPU completion and CPU coherency in the existing capture worker; immutable owned snapshot.
implementation.fallback: Keep previous SHM/readback on absent capability, unsupported pixel format, or failed mapped snapshot.
implementation.remaining_bottleneck: GPU completion wait; copying accounts for about 0.7 ms.
implementation.route_measurement_note: ICMP sample recorded after formal A/B; does not assert an exact RTT for every response or reuse historical 19 ms.

raw_archive.redaction: No video payloads, pixels, clipboard, user app content, authorization or pairing keys. Sessions aliased; process memory pointers removed after readback-ID correlation.
